name: MedAgentsBench
intro: MedAgentsBench 对应论文最新版 MedicalAgentsBench，是一个从八个医学问答数据集按模型难度、人工推理深度、临床有效性和污染风险筛选出的复杂医疗推理基准，最终包含 862 道困难选择题。
org: Yale University, ETH Zurich, Stanford University
build_method: 难度感知筛选、医学专家审核、MELD污染筛查
task_type: 医疗推理, 多项选择问答, Agent方法比较
eval_feature: 低于50%正确率门槛, 五级推理深度, 成本Pareto分析
scale: 862道困难题，8个源数据集，9个评测子集
task_type_en: Medical reasoning, multiple-choice QA, agent-method comparison
build_method_en: Difficulty-aware filtering, medical-expert review, MELD contamination screening
eval_feature_en: Below-50% accuracy gate, five-level reasoning depth, cost Pareto analysis
intro_en: MedAgentsBench corresponds to the current MedicalAgentsBench paper: a complex medical reasoning benchmark filtered from eight medical QA datasets using model difficulty, human reasoning-depth and clinical-validity review, and contamination screening. The final set contains 862 hard multiple-choice questions.
scale_en: 862 hard questions, 8 source datasets, 9 evaluation subsets
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.07459v3, which renames the paper benchmark MedicalAgentsBench and supersedes the stale medagents-benchmark README snapshot. The diagram preserves eight source datasets and nine evaluation subsets, diverse-model difficulty probing, the below-50% correctness gate, the exact balanced 100x7 plus 89 MedBullets plus 73 MMLU distribution totaling 862, four clinical-year medical-student annotators, a five-level reasoning-depth rubric, removal of 21 invalid questions, MELD question-half continuation screening without answer options, average length 147.4 tokens, ten base models, nine externalized reasoning methods, choice accuracy, full-cycle inference time, token/hosting cost, and accuracy-cost Pareto analysis.
